description: Minimum design assertions for Migration Manager pipeline test. These represent the minimal class structure implied by the requirements in migration_manager_requirements.md — the agent may produce additional classes and relationships, but at minimum these must exist.

must_have_classes.name: Migration
must_have_classes.description: Abstract base class. up() and down() take cpp_sqlite::Transaction& (not Database&) per API contract.

must_have_classes.name: SchemaVersion
must_have_classes.description: Record of an applied migration. Must have version, applied_at, checksum per API contract.

must_have_classes.name: MigrationManager
must_have_classes.description: Orchestrates migration registration, application, rollback, and verification.

must_have_classes.name: SchemaMismatch
must_have_classes.description: Describes one schema drift detection in verify().

must_have_classes.name: MismatchKind
must_have_classes.description: Enum for kinds of schema mismatch.

may_also_have_classes.name: SchemaMismatch
may_also_have_classes.description: Report struct from verify() for a single mismatch

may_also_have_classes.name: DuplicateVersionError
may_also_have_classes.description: Error when registering duplicate migration version

must_have_edges.description: Manager registers and calls up()/down() on Migration instances
up() and down() take Transaction& per API contract
